title: Total of the Last K Marks
description: A teacher keeps a list of marks. Write a function named last_k_total that returns the total of the last k marks in the list. If k is larger than the list, return the total of all marks. If k is 0 or marks is empty, return 0.
hints: Slices and index ranges use boundaries that are easy to misjudge, especially when k is 0 or negative.
Inspect how you slice: in Python, marks[-0:] selects the entire list instead of an empty slice!
When k is larger than len(marks), you should clamp the number of summed items to the list length.
Add explicit checks for k <= 0 returning 0, and clamp k = min(k, len(marks)) before slicing or summing.
Use sum(marks[-k:]) only when k > 0, guarding with an if condition beforehand.
